Tropical Weather Outlook
NWS National Hurricane Center Miami FL
Issued by the NWS Weather Prediction Center College Park MD
200 PM EDT Wed Sep 16 2026

For the North Atlantic...Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of America:

Central Subtropical Atlantic (AL98):
A small area of low pressure located several hundred miles east of 
Bermuda has become better defined over the last 24 hours. 
Environmental conditions could become a little more conducive for 
further development in the next few days while the system moves 
slowly westward to southward over the subtropical Atlantic.
* Formation chance through 48 hours...low...20 percent.
* Formation chance through 7 days...low...30 percent.
